name: Ore wa Tsuma Killer ~Tsuma 5nin, Musume 5nin, Oyakodon Okawari!~
original_name: 俺はツマキラー ～妻５人、娘５人、親娘丼おかわりっ！～
source:
I have a woman I love who I've decided to marry. She is kind, good-natured, older than me, and in love with me.

And, of course, she has big boobs. This is important. And she adores me and is proud of me. I'm a little worried about her getting any undesirable lovers.

Work is going well. We finally bought an apartment for the three of us to live together. I can work hard if I think of it as a way to support my beloved family.

Smooth sailing, full of happiness, newlywed life begins! Or at least it was supposed to be...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=719516]getchu[/url]]
